source: Tripo Studio export (v1.0 biped rig, 79 joints), 47 clips; RP0B adds 11 clips (33 total)
units: model height 0.979 u, feet on y=0

clips.name: idle
clips.note: loop, 15.3 s breathing/weight shift

clips.name: walk
clips.note: loop; native speed 0.68 height/s (0.66 u/s; a 1.7 m hero = 1.2 m/s)

clips.name: run
clips.note: loop (end blended into start 0.4 s); native speed 2.46 u/s (a 1.7 m hero = 4.3 m/s)

clips.name: jump
clips.note: one hop cut from the 4-hop Tripo clip: squat → air → land

clips.name: fall
clips.note: air pose loop (hip height rebased to standing; the game sets the height)

clips.name: land
clips.note: touch-down → deep crouch → stand

clips.name: dodge
clips.note: dive roll cut from Tripo 'dive' (wind-up removed); play at timeScale ~2 for a 0.85 s dodge

clips.name: hit
clips.note: flinch, 1.3 s

clips.name: death
clips.note: shot → stagger → kneel → fall → lies; clamp on the last frame; root keeps its travel

clips.name: knockdown
clips.note: stumble + fall + lies (Tripo 'fall'); root keeps its travel

clips.name: punch_a
clips.note: punch combo (Tripo box_01)

clips.name: punch_b
clips.note: punch combo (Tripo box_02)

clips.name: kick_a
clips.note: spinning kick (Tripo front_kick_01, body yaws ~190°)

clips.name: kick_b
clips.note: back kick (Tripo front_kick_02)

clips.name: cast
clips.note: arm thrust forward, spell (Tripo cast_a_spell)

clips.name: aim
clips.note: arm out, aiming/pointing (Tripo fire); holds

clips.name: talk
clips.note: nod/agree 4 s

clips.name: bow
clips.note: bow 6 s

clips.name: cry
clips.note: cry 7.9 s

clips.name: cheer
clips.note: first 5 s of Tripo cheer

clips.name: angry
clips.note: arms crossed + stomp (Tripo angry_03)

clips.name: sit_down
clips.from: SYNTHESIZED (procedural): hero idle pose -> sit pose, local slerp + forward lean + eased hip, feet locked front/back
clips.note: stand -> seated; origin = the feet; hip ends lower and behind them (see hip_travel_u); seat is where the hip ends

clips.name: sit_idle
clips.note: loop 1.67 s, seated (hands on thighs); hip offset matches the end of sit_down

clips.name: stand_up
clips.from: SYNTHESIZED (procedural): sit pose -> hero idle pose
clips.note: exact reverse path of sit_down with a forward lean; ends on the hero idle first frame

clips.name: slash_a
clips.note: 1st hit; wind-up crouch -> lunge -> right arm high; sword goes in the right hand (game attaches it)

clips.name: slash_b
clips.note: 2nd hit; twist -> deep low lunge -> arm out

clips.name: slash_c
clips.note: 3rd hit / finisher; low reach -> rise (same source clip as heavy, different window)

clips.name: heavy
clips.note: heavy lunge sweep (NOT overhead: no overhead swing exists in the shipped sources)

clips.name: block
clips.note: guard crouch, loop-able hold (forward+reverse = seamless)

clips.name: swim
clips.note: surface stroke, horizontal body; hip stays at ~0.19 u (the game sets the water height)

clips.name: climb
clips.note: hand-over-hand/leg-step climb, in place: linear drift removed in X, Y and Z (hip bobs around the standing hip height)

clips.name: interact
clips.note: reach forward with the right arm, hold, return
